items.source:
This will expose the current Spring AOP invocation (necessary for some AspectJ pointcut
matching) and make available the current AspectJ JoinPoint. The call will have no effect
if there are no AspectJ advisors in the advisor chain.
items.translation: 这将暴露当前的 Spring AOP 调用（对于某些 AspectJ 切入点匹配是必需的），并使当前的 AspectJ JoinPoint 可用。如果顾问链中没有 AspectJ 顾问，该调用将不产生任何效果。

items.source: Add special advisors if necessary to work with a proxy chain that contains AspectJ advisors: concretely, ExposeInvocationInterceptor at the beginning of the list.
items.translation: 如有必要，请添加特殊顾问以处理包含 AspectJ 顾问的代理链：具体而言，在列表开头添加 ExposeInvocationInterceptor。

items.source: true if an ExposeInvocationInterceptor was added to the list, otherwise false
items.translation: 如果已添加 `ExposeInvocationInterceptor` 到列表中，则返回 `true`，否则返回 `false`。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Ramnivas Laddad, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Rod Johnson、Ramnivas Laddad 和 Juergen Hoeller

items.source: Utility methods for working with AspectJ proxies.
items.translation: 用于处理 AspectJ 代理的工具方法。
